record.question: What is the advantage of a coated tablet over an uncoated tablet for use as an orally administered drug?
options: Coated tablets usually have faster disintegration time which may increase the bioavailability of the drug
record.explanation: Answer B: Taste masking of unpalatable drugs. Coating can mask unpleasant taste or odor and improve acceptability; faster disintegration and lower cost are not general advantages. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562178/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
